reported_success.location: Printed p. 2, Introduction (overall paper verdict; effect-specific verdict unresolved)
reported_success.quote: Our results confirm the evidence documented in Poole (2013) which suggests that when workers leave multinationals and are rehired at domestic establishments, the wages of workers who are already in these establishments and remain increase. We also document broadly similar tendencies in terms of heterogeneity. However, the comparisons across subsamples are not significant bar some few exceptions for Ireland.
